content.comment_body: I've been reviewing the operation of our various [product_name] units by accessing their [product_name] BM or TD interfaces. Occasionally, the display appears blank for unknown reasons. Despite this, I can still interact with the device—if I visit the [product_name] Variable screen, I can select a VM location and observe the value updating. Using [product_name] software for an online test also shows the screen correctly. Any suggestions on how to resolve this?
It's difficult to diagnose remotely. Does any message text appear on the [product_name] web server when the blank screen issue occurs?

Yes, in the [product_name] software's Online Test, the correct display is visible while the web view remains blank. Full access for the [product_name] is enabled. The behavior is consistent across both Chrome and Firefox browsers.
Could you upload your program in a zip archive for review?

I am attaching the project code file that manages our entire network of [product_name] devices. The problematic unit is identified as '[product_name] 19 Dirty water' with the code 'Dirty water.lsc', while '[product_name] 15 Cheese master' with the code 'Cheese master.lsc' operates without issue. All devices are interconnected, allowing error messages to be sent to our [product_name] CMR, which also receives commands from the same module.
Unfortunately, I haven't identified why the message texts aren't displaying on the web server. Consider starting a support request with [company_name] for further assistance.

Hello, In your 'Dirty water.lsc' program, there are two message text function blocks. Both are currently disabled for display on the web server, as shown in the attached images. Enable both blocks, and that should resolve the issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing intermittent blank screens when using [product_name] BM and TD web displays, despite ongoing device communication and variable monitoring. The issue only impacts the web interface, as local or software-based online tests function properly. Users are unsure whether the problem is related to configuration settings or a system fault, and there is a need for clearer configuration instructions or diagnostic tools.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect stable and consistent visualization of [product_name] screens via the web interface. They want any configuration errors or technical issues to be clearly indicated and easily avoidable, aiming for remote monitoring to reliably match the local testing experience.
